literature.title: Academic engagement and commercialisation A review of the literature on university–industry relations

use.zh: 区分学术合作与知识产权商业化，分别考虑个人、组织和制度层面的条件。
use.en: Separate academic engagement from commercialisation and distinguish individual, organisational and institutional conditions.

use.zh: 将合作组织形式、动机、形成与运行过程分开编码，避免把面临的问题当作模式名称。
use.en: Distinguish organisational form, motivation and collaboration processes rather than using barriers as modes.

literature.title: What makes industry–university collaboration succeed A systematic review of the literature

use.zh: 按机构、关系、产出要求与外部环境组织影响因素，并考察合作阶段与学科差异。
use.en: Organise determinants into institutional, relationship, output and framework factors, with stage and discipline as moderators.

literature.title: Context perspective on University-Industry Collaboration processes A systematic review of literature

use.zh: 研究合作、创业商业化和教育合作并列，不将不同经济环境中的合作方式视为统一发展阶梯。
use.en: Treat research, entrepreneurship and educational collaboration as complementary forms rather than a universal development ladder.

literature.title: Proximity and Innovation A Critical Assessment

use.zh: 地理接近不能代替认知、组织、社会及制度匹配，也需要警惕封闭网络的路径锁定。
use.en: Geographical proximity does not replace cognitive, organisational, social or institutional fit; excessive proximity may cause lock-in.

literature.title: The dynamics of innovation from National Systems and Mode 2 to a Triple Helix of university–industry–government relations

use.zh: 记录大学、企业与政府的实际职责和相互作用，不仅统计参与者名称。
use.en: Describe the roles and interactions of universities, industry and government, not merely their presence.

literature.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship

use.zh: 采用稳定标识、关联来源、机器可读表格和版本化数据。
use.en: Use stable identifiers, linked provenance, machine-readable tables and versioned releases.

literature.title: A news-based climate policy uncertainty index for China

use.zh: 参考其来源分层、可复核编码和验证结构；不移用该研究的准确率或不确定性指数。
use.en: Inform source stratification, coding documentation and validation design, without transferring its accuracy estimates or index.

literature.title: A high-precision catalogue of landslide events in China based on news text mining with large language model

use.zh: 借鉴事件与报道分离、时间精度分级和字段级验证，不把模型输出直接视为事实。
use.en: Inform separation of events from reports, temporal precision and field-level validation.

literature.title: Multilingual news dataset about Ukraine 2022–2025 data collection and documentation

use.zh: 保留原文与译文，公开字段定义和缺失情况，将启发式标签与人工真值区分。
use.en: Retain originals and translations, document missingness, and distinguish heuristic labels from ground truth.

advantage.zh: 科研团队可借助创业服务和资本快速测试产品与市场。
advantage.en: Entrepreneurial teams can test products and markets with venture support.

risk.zh: 早期投资偏好可能挤压长周期技术，专利许可与团队权益容易产生摩擦。
risk.en: Investment horizons may not fit long development cycles; licensing and ownership can impede transfer.

conditions.zh: 稳定的技术许可安排、技术经理人以及可持续的早期资金。
conditions.en: Clear licensing, translation expertise and sustained early finance.

policy.zh: 资助概念验证和首批应用验证，分别考核技术里程碑与市场检验。
policy.en: Support proof of concept and first applications with separate technical and market milestones.

advantage.zh: 围绕明确技术难题配置科研、企业与公共资源，适合高不确定性攻关。
advantage.en: Aligns research, industry and public resources around difficult technical problems.

risk.zh: 任务设置僵化或只有项目结束考核，可能延缓路线调整和后续应用。
risk.en: Rigid objectives and end-only evaluation can delay course correction and adoption.

conditions.zh: 可验证的任务边界、阶段性评审以及后续示范和采购接口。
conditions.en: Testable objectives, staged reviews and downstream demonstration or procurement.

policy.zh: 允许按验证结果调整技术路线，提前明确试验场景和成果接续责任。
policy.en: Permit evidence-led changes and specify validation settings and follow-on responsibilities.

advantage.zh: 专业工程团队将企业需求转成科研任务，减少双方寻找合作方和沟通的成本。
advantage.en: Translation teams turn industrial needs into research tasks and reduce search costs.

risk.zh: 长期依赖补贴或只接短期服务订单，可能削弱持续研发与公共技术积累。
risk.en: Subsidy dependence or short contracts may weaken research continuity.

conditions.zh: 稳定工程人才、透明合同科研规则，以及公共任务与商业服务分账。
conditions.en: Engineering staff, transparent contracts and separate public and commercial accounts.

policy.zh: 同时评价企业复购、技术服务质量与公共研发贡献，不单看机构营收。
policy.en: Assess repeat demand, service quality and public research contributions rather than revenue alone.

advantage.zh: 不同机构共享互补知识、设备和应用场景，可承担单个机构难以完成的任务。
advantage.en: Combines complementary knowledge, equipment and application settings.

risk.zh: 伙伴越多，协调、知识产权分配和跨境合规成本可能越高。
risk.en: Coordination, intellectual property and cross-border compliance become costly.

conditions.zh: 明确的工作包、数据使用权、成果归属与持续沟通机制。
conditions.en: Clear work packages, data rights, ownership and sustained communication.

policy.zh: 在立项时约定成果和数据权限，并为中小企业提供合同与合规支持。
policy.en: Agree rights early and offer contractual and compliance support to smaller firms.

advantage.zh: 共享真实或接近真实的工况，帮助检验放大、安全性和可靠性。
advantage.en: Shared operating conditions support scale-up, safety and reliability testing.

risk.zh: 设施投入高，缺少持续客户和开放规则时容易出现低利用率。
risk.en: High fixed costs require demand and workable access rules.

conditions.zh: 经过验证的产业需求、运营工程师和清楚的费用及责任规则。
conditions.en: Demonstrated demand, operating engineers and clear charging and liability rules.

policy.zh: 先核实企业试验需求，再建设或整合设施，考核有效试验和企业使用。
policy.en: Verify demand before investment and assess completed tests and industrial use.

advantage.zh: 相邻企业与科研服务机构可缩短需求反馈和工程迭代周期。
advantage.en: Nearby firms and research services can shorten feedback and iteration cycles.

risk.zh: 空间集聚不保证知识合作，封闭供应网络也可能固化既有技术路线。
risk.en: Co-location does not ensure collaboration and closed networks can lock in trajectories.

conditions.zh: 实际供应链联系、跨机构工程人才流动，以及对外合作渠道。
conditions.en: Real supply-chain ties, mobile engineering talent and external partnerships.

policy.zh: 支持共享工程服务与企业提出的问题，避免把园区面积当作创新成效。
policy.en: Support shared engineering services and industrial problems rather than park expansion.

advantage.zh: 通过联合培养、导师与创业辅导积累本地吸收和应用技术的能力。
advantage.en: Training and mentoring build local capabilities to absorb and apply knowledge.

risk.zh: 培训与真实岗位、客户或研发任务脱节时，难以形成持续合作。
risk.en: Training disconnected from jobs, customers or research tasks may not sustain collaboration.

conditions.zh: 企业参与培养任务，具备工程导师和后续实践岗位。
conditions.en: Industry-defined tasks, engineering mentors and subsequent practice opportunities.

policy.zh: 将联合培养与企业研发、试验或生产改进任务结合，跟踪后续技术应用。
policy.en: Link training to industrial research and production tasks and track subsequent applications.

advantage.zh: 明确数据、标准和技术交易接口，降低跨机构技术交换的不确定性。
advantage.en: Clarifies data, standards and transaction interfaces across organisations.

risk.zh: 认证和数据治理成本可能提高进入门槛，规则成员身份也不等于实际应用。
risk.en: Compliance costs can raise entry barriers; membership does not establish adoption.

conditions.zh: 互操作规范、可执行的数据权限和中小企业能够承担的合规成本。
conditions.en: Interoperable specifications, enforceable rights and affordable compliance.

policy.zh: 把合规服务与试点应用结合，记录采用效果和参与门槛。
policy.en: Combine compliance services with pilots and monitor adoption and entry barriers.
